INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.message: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.message: Database is not reachable. Please try again shortly.

INVALID_JSON.message: Request body is not valid JSON.

TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.message: Too many requests. Please slow down and try again in a moment.

CORS_NOT_ALLOWED.message: Origin '{origin}' is not allowed to call this API.

VALIDATION_FAILED.message: Request validation failed. Check 'details' for the invalid fields.

FIELD_TOO_SHORT.message: {field} must be at least {min} character(s) long.

FIELD_TOO_LONG.message: {field} must be at most {max} character(s) long.

FIELD_INVALID_EMAIL.message: {field} must be a valid email address.

FIELD_INVALID_DATE.message: {field} must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

FIELD_INVALID_ID.message: {field} must be a positive whole number.

FIELD_INVALID_DECIMAL.message: {field} must be a number with at most {scale} decimal place(s).

FIELD_DATE_BEFORE_ORDER.message: {field} cannot be before the order date.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.message: Header 'Idempotency-Key' is required for this operation so that retries cannot be processed twice.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.message: Header 'Idempotency-Key' must be 8-100 characters using letters, digits, '-', '_' or ':'.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.message: Idempotency-Key '{key}' was already used for a different request. Generate a new key for a new operation.

DUPLICATE_RESOURCE.message: A record with the same unique value already exists.

REFERENCED_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.message: A referenced record does not exist.

CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION.message: The operation violates a data integrity rule ({constraint}).

VENDOR_NOT_FOUND.message: Vendor with id {vendorId} does not exist.

VENDOR_INACTIVE.message: Vendor {vendorCode} is inactive and cannot be used for new transactions.

VENDOR_CODE_EXISTS.message: A vendor with code '{code}' already exists.

PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND.message: Product with id {productId} does not exist.

PRODUCTS_NOT_FOUND.message: These product id(s) do not exist or are inactive: {productIds}.

PRODUCT_SKU_EXISTS.message: A product with SKU '{sku}' already exists.

PURCHASE_ORDER_NOT_FOUND.message: Purchase order with id {purchaseOrderId} does not exist.

PO_DUPLICATE_PRODUCT.message: Product {productId} appears more than once. Combine the quantities into a single line.

PO_VENDOR_MISMATCH.message: Purchase order {poNumber} does not belong to vendor {vendorId}.

PO_ALREADY_FULLY_RECEIVED.message: Purchase order {poNumber} has already been fully received. Duplicate receipt rejected.

RECEIPT_DUPLICATE_ITEM.message: Purchase order item {purchaseOrderItemId} appears more than once in this receipt.

RECEIPT_ITEM_NOT_IN_PO.message: Item {purchaseOrderItemId} does not belong to purchase order {poNumber}.

RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_PENDING_QTY.message: Cannot receive {requested} of '{productName}': only {pending} is still pending on {poNumber}.

PAYMENT_NO_OUTSTANDING.message: Vendor {vendorCode} has no outstanding balance. Advance payments are not supported.

PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING.message: Payment of {amount} exceeds the outstanding balance of {outstanding} for vendor {vendorCode}.

PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_PO_OUTSTANDING.message: Payment of {amount} exceeds the outstanding balance of {outstanding} on purchase order {poNumber}.
